feature: Batch Recall with Sales & Distribution Block Placement

envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-036-001.name: Valid Batch-Managed Material with Existing Batch — Primary Happy Path
TD-CS-036-001.expectedOutcome: Sales & Distribution block successfully placed on batch; confirmation message displayed; batch status updated to SD block active

TD-CS-036-NEG-001.name: Sales Order Creation for Blocked Batch — Negative Validation
TD-CS-036-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: SAP prevents sales order creation; error message displayed: Batch is blocked for sales and distribution; no sales order number generated

TD-CS-036-NEG-002.name: Delivery Processing for Blocked Batch — Negative Validation
TD-CS-036-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: SAP prevents delivery creation and processing; error message displayed: Batch is blocked for sales and distribution; no delivery number generated

TD-CS-036-NEG-003.name: SD Block on Non-Existent Batch — Negative Validation
TD-CS-036-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Batch does not exist; batch details not loaded; SD block placement disabled; no SD block applied

TD-CS-036-NEG-004.name: SD Block on Non-Batch-Managed Material — Negative Validation
TD-CS-036-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Material is not batch-managed; batch field disabled or inaccessible; SD block placement disabled; no SD block applied

TD-CS-036-ERR-001.name: Missing Batch Number — Mandatory Field Validation
TD-CS-036-ERR-001.note: batchNumber intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-036-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Batch field as mandatory; validation message displayed: Batch number is required; SD block placement disabled

TD-CS-036-ERR-002.name: Missing Material Number — Mandatory Field Validation
TD-CS-036-ERR-002.note: materialNumber intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-036-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Material field as mandatory; validation message displayed: Material number is required; batch search disabled; SD block placement disabled

TD-CS-036-INT-001.name: QM Batch Status Change Triggers SD Block — Integration Test
TD-CS-036-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Quality status changed in QM module; SD block automatically propagated to SD module; confirmation message displayed; audit trail logged with timestamp and user ID

TD-CS-036-INT-002.name: Existing Sales Orders Flagged for Blocked Batch — Integration Test
TD-CS-036-INT-002.expectedOutcome: SD block placed on batch; existing sales order flagged with warning; sales order or delivery status shows blocked; impact report lists affected sales orders with recommended actions
